description: This file defines the routes for session tracking in a Node.js Express application. It includes route handlers for listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting session tracking records, with detailed filtering, pagination, search, and scope logic.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests for listing session tracking records with support for pagination, filtering, searching, tenant scoping, and date range filtering.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a session tracking record by its ID using a generic controller method.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new session tracking record using a generic controller method.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing session tracking record by ID using a generic controller method.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a session tracking record by ID using a generic controller method.
